name: Chicken Ranch Pita Pizza with Corn, Spicy Honey & Romaine Salad
ingredients: 1 (30 oz) whole chicken rotisserie chicken, white and dark meat
instructions: Place chicken on a cutting board and, using your hands, remove meat from the skin and bones. Separate the meat into shred-like pieces, place in a medium bowl, and set aside.
Place corn in a colander and run under hot water (from the tap) to defrost.
Place pitas on a large baking sheet pan; spread evenly with dressing, then sprinkle with cheese.
Top pitas with chicken, corn, and more cheese.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until pita pizzas are golden and cheese is melted 6-8 minutes.
Meanwhile, place honey and hot sauce in a clean small bowl; stir to combine and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim, seed, and slice bell pepper lengthwise into thin strips; place in a medium bowl.
Chop or tear romaine into bite-sized pieces; add to the bowl with the bell pepper.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl along with additional dressing and salt; toss to combine the salad.
When the pizzas are done, remove from oven and drizzle with spicy honey; cut into wedges.
To serve, divide pizzas and salad between plates. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
